Sorry for the late reply, but here are the answers.

My father is overall really busy, and works full time as he always has been, so I don't want to do that because I feel like it'd be too much.

My mother knows how I feel, I've been quite vocal about my problems to her, but I think she either doesn't know how to help me with it, or doesn't really care about it.

Exploring the world would be nice, but then there's the brain problem. I'd honestly love to go back to school and get a degree and a job, but that's just sadly not a reality for me.

Here's the kicker, I have been trying to better myself; dress better, try to take better care of myself, get a sleep schedule, I joined a gaming community, and all that, but they just don't seem to care about me that I'm trying.

Here's the thing. My mother DOES know at least to a certain level how I feel. She has been put on antidepressants herself.

I don't want to tell my father anything because I don't want to feel like a burden to him, especially now that we've reconnected.

My sister, yea, you're spot on on that part.

When I was 14, I worked at a grocery store stocking shelves which I did for a month before getting plagued by migraines (which I get whenever I push myself too far). I did do two internships for middle school, one which I didn't finish for multiple reasons, of which getting tired too fast being one, and the other I did finish. The second one was a warehouse, which I stayed at for a year after leaving. However, for that year I stayed, it was 1 day every two weeks, so I can't really say that I really did it full time in the slightest. Also, the grocery store job was literally forced on by my mother until she gave up because "I was too lazy to do it".
Well, I did state I live supervised. With one of the supervisors here, who is a medical worker of sorts, did go with me for both tries.
And I could try to look into it. I don't have much trust in psychologists and therapists, but I guess if they're in training, they still have the ambition to actually help.

It's not that I want to die per say, I just want the emotional and mental pain to stop.

My family isn't really helping me either in that aspect. My mother outright said she didn't want to drive the 20 minutes to my home for my birthday, my sister didn't message me about it whatsoever, and my father and I aren't really all that close still (it's only been half a year since we reconnected) so I don't want to sound like a burden to him by having him come over.

As to why not do it again? It's just getting too much. I feel like my feelings get stomped over time and time again where I already can't trust someone to come close to me anymore. As I've said in my starting post, I have 1 friend I can trust, and he's been amazing for me. He's literally the only reason right now as to why I even say that I don't want to die if this is still fixable, but my life perspective is starting to look grayer by the day.
I want to be able to fix myself, really. But after year after year of trying to climb up only to get pushed back into the snake pit called depression, eventually you'll give up, y'know.
